note: What each sprite shows, described by an agent that was shown the picture and NOT the piece's name. Blind on purpose: a reader told the name confirms the name.

readings.detail: An irregular hexagonal grey slab with dark fracture lines running across its face and a chipped notch out of the upper right edge; bevelled highlight along the top-left.
A quilted pale beige top sheet drawn in perspective over stacked coloured under-layers (white, rust red, dark blue), with a ragged dark hole burnt through the middle of the top face.
Two angular flat fragments with gridded blue faces and pale edges, tilted apart from each other as if split from one gridded panel.
Roughly a dozen thin straight bars crossing at random angles in a loose flat mat, drawn in mottled brown with lighter speckling along their lengths.
A symmetrical hourglass form flaring wide at the top and again at the base, with vertical shading bands and a darker throat at the narrow waist; upright, viewed side-on.
A shallow concave grey dish tilted up on a small trapezoid base, with a thin arm reaching from the rim to a knob suspended over the centre; the dish rim is dented and split on the lower right.
One long diagonal shaft carrying about ten short bars set across it at intervals, several of them kinked or snapped off short, with a small blue-grey lump near the lower end.

readings.depicts: A boxy unit in a yellow frame
readings.detail: A dark grey slab body wrapped in a thick yellow border, tilted on its side; a small square inset with a pale dot sits at the upper left of the dark face.
Eight spokes running from a small central hub to a wide flat rim, shown flat-on; a short notch breaks the rim at the lower right.
Three or four angular chunks with dark pitted faces and pale chipped edges pressed together, the largest wedge leaning right; no flat or manufactured surfaces.
An irregular stepped grey plate with six small bolt holes near its corners and two short scratch lines scored across the middle; seen face-on.
A pair of tall rectangular wings side by side, each ruled into a grid of dark blue cells with pale dividing lines and a light frame; the right wing is tilted slightly out of line with the left.
A short cylinder lying on its side with a ringed barrel and a round dark front element holding a bright cyan glint; a separate stubby ring section sits behind it to the right.

readings.depicts: A thick ring or hatch rim
readings.detail: A heavy circular band drawn in outline with a hollow centre, thicker and lighter on the left side, with a gap broken out of the upper right and three small loose specks floating beside it.

readings.depicts: A ribbed cylinder with a hose
readings.detail: A stack of pale ridged discs forming a corrugated drum on the right, joined to a blocky tan housing on the left from which a dark brown tube loops up over the top and back down.

readings.depicts: A torn sheet of grey metal
readings.detail: An irregular ragged-edged plate with a crease running through it and small loose chips floating off to the right; shown at an angle.
A cylindrical roll banded around the middle with tan straps, blue quilted material at both ends, lying diagonally.
A rounded rectangular frame with bevelled corners holding pale blue glass, cracks radiating from a dark star-shaped hole in the centre.

An upright grey cabinet with a blue screen, a grid of small holes, two rows of coloured indicator strips and buttons, with a red and a blue cable looping out of the bottom and a yellow rod jutting from the top right.
A tapering grey cone or nose piece with a narrow raised rib down the middle and a jagged broken edge along the bottom.
A green rectangular board with two large black chips, a red component, small blue and yellow parts, and a row of gold contact fingers along the bottom edge; a metal tab sticks out at the left.
A jagged green fragment with two yellow stripes and a couple of small chips, a separated splinter floating to its left and a curled rust-brown wire hanging below.

readings.depicts: A parabolic dish on a mount
readings.detail: A grey dish seen at a three-quarter angle with a strut-mounted feed arm crossing its face, sitting on a blocky base; the rim is dented and irregular.

readings.depicts: An empty picture frame with broken glass
readings.detail: A square dark-blue frame whose interior holds only pale cyan shards angled inward from the corners, leaving a hollow middle.
A twisted braided rope-like strand running diagonally, frayed and splayed into a bristly knot at the upper right end.
A grey open-topped case divided into compartments holding blocky cells, each with coloured bars — yellow, red, orange — marking charge levels.
A bright cyan rounded tank lying on its side with stub fittings at each end and a small nozzle on top; `H2O` is stencilled in dark letters across the middle panel.
A flared cone standing upright with stacked ring ridges down its body, a dark sooty throat, and a rust-brown crusted rim at the base.
A small six-sided ring seen face-on with a round hole through the middle and a light highlight on the upper left; nothing else in the cell.
A grey cylinder lying diagonally with rimmed ends and two yellow bands around its body; the lower left end is dented and a small chip is broken off beside it.
